f: How many basic patterns (abwāb) are there for the triliteral verb (الفعل الثلاثي المجرد)?
b: There are six basic patterns.

f: What is the first pattern of the triliteral verb?
b: فَعَلَ يَفْعُلُ (faʿala yafʿulu).

f: What is the standard example (وزن) of فَعَلَ يَفْعُلُ?
b: نَصَرَ يَنْصُرُ.

f: How is فَعَلَ يَفْعُلُ recognized?
b: Its middle radical (عين الفعل) has fatḥah in the past tense and ḍammah in the present tense.

f: What is the usual function of the pattern فَعَلَ يَفْعُلُ?
b: It is usually transitive (متعدٍّ).

f: Can فَعَلَ يَفْعُلُ also be intransitive?
b: Yes, it can sometimes be intransitive (لازم).

f: What is an example of a transitive verb on the pattern فَعَلَ يَفْعُلُ?
b: نَصَرَ زَيْدٌ عَمْرًا (Zayd helped Amr).

f: What is an example of an intransitive verb on the pattern فَعَلَ يَفْعُلُ?
b: خَرَجَ زَيْدٌ (Zayd exited).

f: What is a transitive verb (المتعدي)?
b: A verb whose action passes from the doer to an object (المفعول به).

f: What is an intransitive verb (اللازم)?
b: A verb whose action does not pass to an object but remains with the subject itself.

f: What is the second pattern of the triliteral verb?
b: فَعَلَ يَفْعِلُ (faʿala yafʿilu).

f: What is the standard example of فَعَلَ يَفْعِلُ?
b: ضَرَبَ يَضْرِبُ.

f: How is فَعَلَ يَفْعِلُ recognized?
b: Its middle radical has fatḥah in the past tense and kasrah in the present tense.

f: What is the usual function of فَعَلَ يَفْعِلُ?
b: It is usually transitive, though it may also be intransitive.

f: What is an example of a transitive verb on فَعَلَ يَفْعِلُ?
b: ضَرَبَ زَيْدٌ عَمْرًا (Zayd struck Amr).

f: What is an example of an intransitive verb on فَعَلَ يَفْعِلُ?
b: جَلَسَ زَيْدٌ (Zayd sat).

f: What is the third pattern of the triliteral verb?
b: فَعَلَ يَفْعَلُ (faʿala yafʿalu).

f: What is the standard example of فَعَلَ يَفْعَلُ?
b: فَتَحَ يَفْتَحُ.

f: How is فَعَلَ يَفْعَلُ recognized?
b: Its middle radical has fatḥah in both the past and present tense.

f: What condition is required for فَعَلَ يَفْعَلُ?
b: The middle or final radical must be one of the throat letters (حروف الحلق).

f: What are the throat letters (حروف الحلق)?
b: ء (hamzah), هـ (hā’), ع (ʿayn), ح (ḥā’), غ (ghayn), and خ (khā’).

f: Why does فَعَلَ يَفْعَلُ usually have fatḥah in the present tense?
b: Because one of its radicals is a throat letter.

f: What is an example of a transitive verb on فَعَلَ يَفْعَلُ?
b: فَتَحَ زَيْدٌ الْبَابَ (Zayd opened the door).

f: What is an example of an intransitive verb on فَعَلَ يَفْعَلُ?
b: ذَهَبَ زَيْدٌ (Zayd went).

f: What is the fourth pattern of the triliteral verb?
b: فَعِلَ يَفْعَلُ (faʿila yafʿalu).

f: What is the standard example of فَعِلَ يَفْعَلُ?
b: عَلِمَ يَعْلَمُ.

f: How is فَعِلَ يَفْعَلُ recognized?
b: Its middle radical has kasrah in the past tense and fatḥah in the present tense.

f: What is the usual function of فَعِلَ يَفْعَلُ?
b: It is usually transitive, although it may also be intransitive.

f: What is an example of a transitive verb on فَعِلَ يَفْعَلُ?
b: عَلِمَ زَيْدٌ الْمَسْأَلَةَ (Zayd knew the issue).

f: What is an example of an intransitive verb on فَعِلَ يَفْعَلُ?
b: وَجِلَ زَيْدٌ (Zayd became fearful).

f: What is the fifth pattern of the triliteral verb?
b: فَعُلَ يَفْعُلُ (faʿula yafʿulu).

f: What is the standard example of فَعُلَ يَفْعُلُ?
b: حَسُنَ يَحْسُنُ.

f: How is فَعُلَ يَفْعُلُ recognized?
b: Its middle radical has ḍammah in both the past and present tense.

f: Is فَعُلَ يَفْعُلُ transitive or intransitive?
b: It is always intransitive (لازم).

f: What is an example of فَعُلَ يَفْعُلُ?
b: حَسُنَ زَيْدٌ (Zayd became good/beautiful).

f: What is the sixth pattern of the triliteral verb?
b: فَعِلَ يَفْعِلُ (faʿila yafʿilu).

f: What is the standard example of فَعِلَ يَفْعِلُ?
b: حَسِبَ يَحْسِبُ.

f: How is فَعِلَ يَفْعِلُ recognized?
b: Its middle radical has kasrah in both the past and present tense.

f: What is the usual function of فَعِلَ يَفْعِلُ?
b: It is usually transitive, although it may sometimes be intransitive.

f: What is an example of a transitive verb on فَعِلَ يَفْعِلُ?
b: حَسِبَ زَيْدٌ عَمْرًا فَاضِلًا (Zayd considered Amr virtuous).

f: What is an example of an intransitive verb on فَعِلَ يَفْعِلُ?
b: وَرِثَ زَيْدٌ (Zayd inherited).

f: How many chapters (أبواب) are there for verbs that are augmented beyond the triliteral root (ما زاد على الثلاثي)?
b: There are twelve chapters for verbs that are augmented beyond the triliteral root. They are divided into three types.

f: What is the first type of augmented triliteral verbs?
b: The first type is that in which one letter is added to the triliteral root (ما زيد فيه حرف واحد على الثلاثي). It consists of three chapters.

f: What is the pattern of the first chapter of verbs with one added letter?
b: Its pattern is: أَفْعَلَ يُفْعِلُ إِفْعَالًا. Its example pattern is أَكْرَمَ يُكْرِمُ إِكْرَامًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern أَفْعَلَ يُفْعِلُ?
b: Its sign is that its past tense consists of four letters due to the addition of a hamzah (أ) at its beginning.

f: What is the usual meaning of the pattern أَفْعَلَ?
b: It usually indicates transitivity (التعدية), though it can sometimes be intransitive (لازم).

f: Give an example of أَفْعَلَ being transitive.
b: أَكْرَمَ زَيْدٌ عَمْرًا — "Zayd honoured ʿAmr."

f: Give an example of أَفْعَلَ being intransitive.
b: أَصْبَحَ الرَّجُلُ — "The man entered the morning / became."

f: What is the pattern of the second chapter of verbs with one added letter?
b: Its pattern is: فَعَّلَ يُفَعِّلُ تَفْعِيلًا. Its example pattern is فَرَّحَ يُفَرِّحُ تَفْرِيحًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern فَعَّلَ?
b: Its sign is that the past tense consists of four letters due to adding one letter between the fāʾ and ʿayn of the verb, which is of the same type as the middle radical of the verb.

f: What is the usual meaning of فَعَّلَ?
b: It usually indicates intensification or multiplication (التكثير).

f: In what ways can فَعَّلَ indicate multiplication?
b: It can indicate multiplication in the action itself, in the subject performing the action, or in the object receiving the action.

f: Give an example where فَعَّلَ indicates multiplication in the action.
b: طَوَّفَ زَيْدٌ الكَعْبَةَ — "Zayd circumambulated the Kaʿbah repeatedly."

f: Give an example where فَعَّلَ indicates multiplication in the subject.
b: مَوَّتَ الإِبِلُ — "The camels died in large numbers."

f: Give an example where فَعَّلَ indicates multiplication in the object.
b: غَلَّقَ زَيْدٌ الأَبْوَابَ — "Zayd closed many doors."

f: What is the pattern of the third chapter of verbs with one added letter?
b: Its pattern is: فَاعَلَ يُفَاعِلُ مُفَاعَلَةً وَفِعَالًا وَفِيعَالًا. Its example pattern is قَاتَلَ يُقَاتِلُ مُقَاتَلَةً وَقِتَالًا وَقِيتَالًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern فَاعَلَ?
b: Its sign is that the past tense consists of four letters due to adding an alif between the fāʾ and ʿayn of the verb.

f: What is the usual meaning of فَاعَلَ?
b: It usually indicates participation or mutual action (المشاركة) between two parties.

f: Give an example of فَاعَلَ indicating participation between two people.
b: قَاتَلَ زَيْدٌ عَمْرًا — "Zayd fought ʿAmr."

f: Can فَاعَلَ be used for only one party?
b: Yes, it can sometimes refer to only one party.

f: Give an example of فَاعَلَ used for one party.
b: قَاتَلَهُمُ اللهُ — "May Allah fight them."

f: What is the second type of augmented triliteral verbs?
b: It is that in which two letters are added to the triliteral root (ما زيد فيه حرفان على الثلاثي المجرد). It consists of five chapters.

f: What is the pattern of the first chapter of verbs with two added letters?
b: Its pattern is: انْفَعَلَ يَنْفَعِلُ انْفِعَالًا. Its example pattern is انْكَسَرَ يَنْكَسِرُ انْكِسَارًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern انْفَعَلَ?
b: Its sign is that the past tense consists of five letters due to adding a hamzah and nūn at the beginning.

f: What is the usual meaning of انْفَعَلَ?
b: It usually indicates muṭāwaʿah (المطاوعة).

f: What is the meaning of muṭāwaʿah (المطاوعة)?
b: It is the occurrence of an effect as a result of a transitive action being applied to its object.

f: Give an example of muṭāwaʿah with انْفَعَلَ.
b: كَسَرْتُ الزُّجَاجَ فَانْكَسَرَ ذَلِكَ الزُّجَاجُ — "I broke the glass, so that glass broke."

f: Why is انْكَسَرَ considered muṭāwaʿah?
b: Because the breaking of the glass is an effect that occurred from the action of breaking (كَسَرَ) being applied to it.

f: What is the pattern of the second chapter of verbs with two added letters?
b: Its pattern is: افْتَعَلَ يَفْتَعِلُ افْتِعَالًا. Its example pattern is اجْتَمَعَ يَجْتَمِعُ اجْتِمَاعًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern افْتَعَلَ?
b: Its sign is that the past tense consists of five letters due to adding a hamzah at the beginning and a tāʾ between the fāʾ and ʿayn.

f: What is the usual meaning of افْتَعَلَ?
b: It also commonly indicates muṭāwaʿah.

f: Give an example of افْتَعَلَ indicating muṭāwaʿah.
b: جَمَعْتُ الإِبِلَ فَاجْتَمَعَ ذَلِكَ الإِبِلُ — "I gathered the camels, so those camels gathered."

f: What is the pattern of the third chapter of verbs with two added letters?
b: Its pattern is: افْعَلَّ يَفْعَلُّ افْعِلَالًا. Its example pattern is احْمَرَّ يَحْمَرُّ احْمِرَارًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern افْعَلَّ?
b: Its sign is that the past tense consists of five letters due to adding a hamzah at the beginning and another letter of the same type as the final radical (لام الفعل) at the end.

f: What is the usual meaning of افْعَلَّ?
b: It indicates intensification of an intransitive state (مبالغة اللازم).

f: What meanings are especially associated with افْعَلَّ?
b: It is said to be used especially for colours and physical defects.

f: Give an example of افْعَلَّ for colours.
b: احْمَرَّ زَيْدٌ — "Zayd became red."

f: Give an example of افْعَلَّ for defects.
b: اعْوَرَّ زَيْدٌ — "Zayd became one-eyed."

f: What is the fourth chapter of verbs with two added letters?
b: Its pattern is تَفَعَّلَ يَتَفَعَّلُ تَفَعُّلًا. Its example pattern is تَكَلَّمَ يَتَكَلَّمُ تَكَلُّمًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern تَفَعَّلَ?
b: Its sign is that its past tense consists of five letters due to adding a tāʾ at the beginning and another letter of the same type as the middle radical (ʿayn al-fiʿl) between the fāʾ and ʿayn.

f: What is the usual meaning of تَفَعَّلَ?
b: It usually indicates takalluf (التكلّف).

f: What is the meaning of takalluf (التكلّف)?
b: It means acquiring or achieving something sought gradually, step by step.

f: Give an example of تَفَعَّلَ indicating takalluf.
b: تَعَلَّمْتُ العِلْمَ مَسْأَلَةً بَعْدَ مَسْأَلَةٍ — "I learned knowledge, one issue after another."

f: What is the fifth chapter of verbs with two added letters?
b: Its pattern is تَفَاعَلَ يَتَفَاعَلُ تَفَاعُلًا. Its example pattern is تَبَاعَدَ يَتَبَاعَدُ تَبَاعُدًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern تَفَاعَلَ?
b: Its sign is that its past tense consists of five letters due to adding a tāʾ at the beginning and an alif between the fāʾ and ʿayn.

f: What is the usual meaning of تَفَاعَلَ?
b: It usually indicates mutual action (المشاركة) between two or more parties.

f: Give an example of تَفَاعَلَ indicating participation between two people.
b: تَبَاعَدَ زَيْدٌ عَنْ عَمْرٍو — "Zayd and ʿAmr became distant from each other."

f: Give an example of تَفَاعَلَ indicating participation between two or more people.
b: تَصَالَحَ القَوْمُ — "The people reconciled with one another."

f: What is the third type of augmented triliteral verbs?
b: It is that in which three letters are added to the triliteral root (ما زيد فيه ثلاثة أحرف على الثلاثي). It consists of four chapters.

f: What is the first chapter of verbs with three added letters?
b: Its pattern is اسْتَفْعَلَ يَسْتَفْعِلُ اسْتِفْعَالًا. Its example pattern is اسْتَخْرَجَ يَسْتَخْرِجُ اسْتِخْرَاجًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern اسْتَفْعَلَ?
b: Its sign is that its past tense consists of six letters due to adding hamzah, sīn, and tāʾ at the beginning.

f: What is the usual meaning of اسْتَفْعَلَ?
b: It usually indicates transitivity (التعدية), though it can sometimes be intransitive (لازم).

f: Give an example of اسْتَفْعَلَ being transitive.
b: اسْتَخْرَجَ زَيْدٌ المَالَ — "Zayd extracted the money."

f: Give an example of اسْتَفْعَلَ being intransitive.
b: اسْتَحْجَرَ الطِّينُ — "The clay became stone-like."

f: What other meaning is mentioned for اسْتَفْعَلَ?
b: It is also said to indicate seeking or requesting the action (طلب الفعل).

f: Give an example of اسْتَفْعَلَ meaning seeking.
b: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ — meaning: "I seek forgiveness from Allah Most High."

f: What is the second chapter of verbs with three added letters?
b: Its pattern is افْعَوْعَلَ يَفْعَوْعِلُ افْعِيْعَالًا. Its example pattern is اعْشَوْشَبَ يَعْشَوْشِبُ اعْشِيشَابًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern افْعَوْعَلَ?
b: Its sign is that its past tense consists of six letters due to adding a hamzah at the beginning, another letter of the same type as the middle radical, and a wāw between the middle and final radicals.

f: What is the usual meaning of افْعَوْعَلَ?
b: It indicates intensification of an intransitive state (مبالغة اللازم).

f: Why does افْعَوْعَلَ indicate intensification?
b: Because it expresses a stronger degree of the basic meaning.

f: Give an example showing the difference between عَشَبَ and اعْشَوْشَبَ.
b: عَشَبَتِ الأرضُ means the earth produced vegetation generally, while اعْشَوْشَبَتِ الأرضُ means the earth produced abundant vegetation.

f: What is the third chapter of verbs with three added letters?
b: Its pattern is افْعَوَّلَ يَفْعَوِّلُ افْعِوَّالًا. Its example pattern is اجْلَوَّذَ يَجْلَوِّذُ اجْلِوَّاذًا.

f: What is the sign of the pattern افْعَوَّلَ?
b: Its sign is that its past tense consists of six letters due to adding a hamzah at the beginning and two wāws between the middle and final radicals.

f: What is the usual meaning of افْعَوَّلَ?
b: It also indicates intensification of an intransitive state (مبالغة اللازم).

f: Give an example showing the difference between جَلَذَ and اجْلَوَّذَ.
b: جَلَذَتِ الإبلُ means the camels travelled quickly, while اجْلَوَّذَتِ الإبلُ means the camels travelled with even greater speed.

f: What is the verb pattern افْعَالَّ يَفْعَالُّ افْعِيْعَالاً, and what is its example?
b: The pattern is افْعَالَّ يَفْعَالُّ افْعِيْعَالاً, and its example is احْمَارَّ يَحْمَارُّ احْمِيرَارًا.

f: How is the past tense of the verb pattern افْعَالَّ recognized?
b: The past tense of افْعَالَّ consists of six letters, with an added hamzah at the beginning, an alif between the ʿayn and lām of the verb, and an additional letter of the same type as the lām of the verb at the end.

f: What meaning does the verb pattern افْعَالَّ usually indicate?
b: The pattern افْعَالَّ indicates an intensified form of an intransitive verb (مبالغة اللازم).

f: Why is the pattern افْعَالَّ considered stronger than the pattern افْعَلَّ?
b: The pattern افْعَالَّ expresses a greater degree of intensity than افْعَلَّ.

f: How do the meanings of حَمِرَ, احْمَرَّ, and احْمَارَّ differ?
b: حَمِرَ زَيْدٌ means Zayd had redness generally; احْمَرَّ زَيْدٌ means Zayd became intensely red; احْمَارَّ زَيْدٌ means Zayd became extremely red with even greater intensity.

f: How many patterns exist for verbs derived by adding three letters to a triliteral root?
b: There are four patterns derived by adding three letters to a triliteral root.

f: What is the pattern of the bare quadriliteral verb (الرُّباعي المجرد)?
b: The bare quadriliteral pattern is فَعْلَلَ يُفَعْلِلُ فَعْلَلَةً وَفِعْلَالاً.

f: What example represents the bare quadriliteral pattern فَعْلَلَ يُفَعْلِلُ?
b: The example is دَحْرَجَ يُدَحْرِجُ دَحْرَجَةً وَدِحْرَاجًا.

f: How is the bare quadriliteral verb pattern فَعْلَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized because its past tense has four letters, all of which are original root letters.

f: What is the usual meaning of the bare quadriliteral pattern فَعْلَلَ?
b: It usually indicates transitivity (التعدية), although it can sometimes be intransitive.

f: Give an example of a transitive verb from the bare quadriliteral pattern فَعْلَلَ.
b: دَحْرَجَ زَيْدٌ الحَجَرَ — “Zayd rolled the stone.”

f: Give an example of an intransitive verb from the bare quadriliteral pattern فَعْلَلَ.
b: دَرْبَخَ زَيْدٌ.

f: What are the six forms called that are attached to the quadriliteral pattern دَحْرَجَ?
b: They are called المُلْحَق بالرُّباعي (the forms attached to the quadriliteral).

f: What is the first pattern among the forms attached to the quadriliteral?
b: The first pattern is فَوْعَلَ يُفَوْعِلُ فَوْعَلَةً وَفِيعَالاً.

f: What example represents the pattern فَوْعَلَ يُفَوْعِلُ?
b: The example is حَوْقَلَ يُحَوْقِلُ حَوْقَلَةً وَحِيْقَالاً.

f: How is the pattern فَوْعَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized by the addition of a wāw between the fāʾ and ʿayn of the verb.

f: What is the grammatical function of the pattern فَوْعَلَ?
b: The pattern فَوْعَلَ is only intransitive (لازم).

f: Give an example of the pattern فَوْعَلَ.
b: حَوْقَلَ زَيْدٌ.

f: What is the second pattern among the forms attached to the quadriliteral?
b: The second pattern is فَيْعَلَ يُفَيْعِلُ فَيْعَلَةً وَفِيعَالاً.

f: What example represents the pattern فَيْعَلَ يُفَيْعِلُ?
b: The example is بَيْطَرَ يُبَيْطِرُ بَيْطَرَةً وَبِيْطَارًا.

f: How is the pattern فَيْعَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized by the addition of a yāʾ between the fāʾ and ʿayn of the verb.

f: What is the grammatical function of the pattern فَيْعَلَ?
b: The pattern فَيْعَلَ is only transitive (متعدٍّ).

f: Give an example of the pattern فَيْعَلَ.
b: بَيْطَرَ زَيْدٌ القَلَمَ meaning “Zayd split the pen.”

f: What is the third pattern among the forms attached to the quadriliteral?
b: The third pattern is فَعْوَلَ يُفَعْوِلُ فَعْوَلَةً وَفِعْوَالاً.

f: What example represents the pattern فَعْوَلَ يُفَعْوِلُ?
b: The example is جَهْوَرَ يُجَهْوِرُ جَهْوَرَةً وَجِهْوَارًا.

f: How is the pattern فَعْوَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized by the addition of a wāw between the ʿayn and lām of the verb.

f: What is the grammatical function of the pattern فَعْوَلَ?
b: The pattern فَعْوَلَ indicates transitivity (التعدية).

f: Give an example of the pattern فَعْوَلَ.
b: جَهْوَرَ زَيْدٌ الْقُرْآنَ — “Zayd recited the Qur’an loudly.”

f: What is the fourth pattern among the forms attached to the quadriliteral?
b: The fourth pattern is فَعْيَلَ يُفَعْيِلُ فَعْيَلَةً وَفِعْيَالاً.

f: What example represents the pattern فَعْيَلَ يُفَعْيِلُ?
b: The example is عَثْيَرَ يُعَثْيِرُ عَثْيَرَةً وَعِثْيَارًا.

f: How is the pattern فَعْيَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized by the addition of a yāʾ between the ʿayn and lām of the verb.

f: What is the grammatical function of the pattern فَعْيَلَ?
b: The pattern فَعْيَلَ is intransitive (لازم).

f: Give an example of the pattern فَعْيَلَ.
b: عَثْيَرَ زَيْدٌ meaning “Zayd rose/appeared.”

f: What is the fifth pattern among the forms attached to the quadriliteral?
b: The fifth pattern is فَعْلَلَ يُفَعْلِلُ فَعْلَلَةً وَفِعْلَالاً.

f: What example represents the attached pattern فَعْلَلَ يُفَعْلِلُ?
b: The example is جَلْبَبَ يُجَلْبِبُ جَلْبَبَةً وَجِلْبَابًا.

f: How is the attached pattern جَلْبَبَ يُجَلْبِبُ recognized?
b: It is recognized because its four-letter past tense has an additional letter of the same type as the lām of the verb at the end.

f: What is the grammatical function of the attached pattern جَلْبَبَ يُجَلْبِبُ?
b: It is only transitive (متعدٍّ).

f: Give an example of the attached pattern جَلْبَبَ يُجَلْبِبُ.
b: جَلْبَبَ زَيْدٌ meaning “Zayd wore the jilbāb.”

f: What is the sixth pattern among the forms attached to the quadriliteral?
b: The sixth pattern is فَعْلَى يُفَعْلِي فَعْلَيَةً وَفِعْلَاءً.

f: What example represents the pattern فَعْلَى يُفَعْلِي?
b: The example is سَلْقَى يُسَلْقِي سَلْقَيَةً وَسِلْقَاءً.

f: How is the pattern فَعْلَى recognized?
b: It is recognized because its past tense has four letters with an added yāʾ at the end.

f: What is the function of the pattern فَعْلَى?
b: The pattern فَعْلَى indicates transitivity (التعدية).

f: Give an example of the pattern فَعْلَى.
b: سَلْقَيْتُ رَجُلاً — “I threw/struck a man down.”

f: What are the six patterns attached to the quadriliteral called?
b: They are called المُلْحَق بالرُّباعي (the patterns attached to the quadriliteral).

f: What does the term الإلحاق mean in morphology?
b: It means that the two verbal forms share the same verbal noun (المصدر), meaning the attached form and the form it is attached to have the same مصدر pattern.

f: How many types exist for verbs that add letters to the bare quadriliteral (الرُّباعي المجرد)?
b: There are two types: verbs with one added letter and verbs with two added letters.

f: What is the only pattern where one letter is added to the bare quadriliteral?
b: The pattern is تَفَعْلَلَ يَتَفَعْلَلُ تَفَعْلُلاً.

f: What example represents the pattern تَفَعْلَلَ derived from the quadriliteral?
b: The example is تَدَحْرَجَ يَتَدَحْرَجُ تَدَحْرُجًا.

f: How is the pattern تَفَعْلَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized because its past tense has five letters with an added tāʾ at the beginning.

f: What meaning does the pattern تَفَعْلَلَ indicate?
b: It indicates mutāwaʿah (المطاوعة), meaning the occurrence of the effect resulting from a transitive action.

f: Give an example of mutāwaʿah using the pattern تَدَحْرَجَ.
b: دَحْرَجْتُ الحَجَرَ فَتَدَحْرَجَ ذَلِكَ الحَجَرُ — “I rolled the stone, and the stone rolled.”

f: How many patterns exist where two letters are added to the bare quadriliteral?
b: There are two patterns.

f: What is the first pattern where two letters are added to the bare quadriliteral?
b: The pattern is افْعَنْلَلَ يَفْعَنْلِلُ افْعِنْلَالاً.

f: What example represents the pattern افْعَنْلَلَ?
b: The example is احْرَنْجَمَ يَحْرَنْجِمُ احْرِنْجَامًا.

f: How is the pattern افْعَنْلَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized because its past tense has six letters with an added hamzah at the beginning and a nūn between the ʿayn and the first lām.

f: What meaning does the pattern افْعَنْلَلَ indicate?
b: It indicates mutāwaʿah (المطاوعة).

f: Give an example of mutāwaʿah using the pattern افْعَنْلَلَ.
b: حَرْجَمْتُ الإِبِلَ فَاحْرَنْجَمَ ذَلِكَ الإِبِلُ — “I gathered the camels, and the camels gathered together.”

f: What is the second pattern where two letters are added to the bare quadriliteral?
b: The pattern is افْعَلَلَّ يَفْعَلِلُّ افْعِلاَّلاً.

f: What example represents the pattern افْعَلَلَّ?
b: The example is اقْشَعَرَّ يَقْشَعِرُّ اقْشِعْرَارًا.

f: How is the pattern افْعَلَلَّ recognized?
b: It is recognized because its past tense has six letters with an added hamzah at the beginning and an additional letter of the same type as the second lām at the end.

f: What meaning does the pattern افْعَلَلَّ indicate?
b: It indicates an intensified intransitive meaning (مبالغة اللازم).

f: How do the meanings of قَشْعَرَ and اقْشَعَرَّ differ?
b: قَشْعَرَ جِلْدُ الرَّجُلِ means the skin’s hair spread generally, while اقْشَعَرَّ جِلْدُ الرَّجُلِ indicates this happening with greater intensity.

f: How many patterns are attached to تَدَحْرَجَ?
b: There are five patterns attached to تَدَحْرَجَ.

f: What is the first pattern attached to تَدَحْرَجَ?
b: The pattern is تَفَعْلَلَ يَتَفَعْلَلُ تَفَعْلُلاً.

f: What example represents the pattern تَفَعْلَلَ attached to تَدَحْرَجَ?
b: The example is تَجَلْبَبَ يَتَجَلْبَبُ تَجَلْبُبًا.

f: How is the attached pattern تَجَلْبَبَ recognized?
b: It is recognized because its past tense has five letters with an added tāʾ at the beginning and another letter of the same type as the lām of the verb at the end.

f: What meaning does the attached pattern تَجَلْبَبَ indicate?
b: It indicates an intransitive meaning (لازم).

f: Give an example of the attached pattern تَجَلْبَبَ.
b: تَجَلْبَبَ زَيْدٌ.

f: What is the second pattern attached to تَدَحْرَجَ?
b: The pattern is تَفَوْعَلَ يَتَفَوْعَلُ تَفَوْعُلاً.

f: What example represents the pattern تَفَوْعَلَ?
b: The example is تَجَوْرَبَ يَتَجَوْرَبُ تَجَوْرُبًا.

f: How is the pattern تَفَوْعَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized because its past tense has five letters with an added tāʾ at the beginning and a wāw between the fāʾ and ʿayn.

f: What meaning does the pattern تَفَوْعَلَ indicate?
b: It indicates an intransitive meaning (لازم).

f: Give an example of the pattern تَفَوْعَلَ.
b: تَجَوْرَبَ زَيْدٌ.

f: What is the pattern of the augmented triliteral verb تَفَعْيَلَ يَتَفَعْيَلُ تَفَعْيُلاً?
b: Its pattern is تَفَعْيَلَ يَتَفَعْيَلُ تَفَعْيُلاً. Its example pattern is تَشَيْطَنَ يَتَشَيْطَنُ تَشَيْطُنًا.

f: How is the pattern تَفَعْيَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized by the past tense having five letters, with an additional تاء at the beginning and an additional ياء between the فاء and عين of the verb.

f: What is the usual meaning/function of the pattern تَفَعْيَلَ?
b: It is generally used for intransitive verbs (اللُّزوم).

f: Give an example of the pattern تَفَعْيَلَ used as an intransitive verb.
b: تَشَيْطَنَ زَيْدٌ — “Zayd became devilish.”

f: What is the pattern of the augmented triliteral verb تَفَعْوَلَ يَتَفَعْوَلُ تَفَعْوُلاً?
b: Its pattern is تَفَعْوَلَ يَتَفَعْوَلُ تَفَعْوُلاً. Its example pattern is تَرَهْوَكَ يَتَرَهْوَكُ تَرَهْوُكًا.

f: How is the pattern تَفَعْوَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized by the past tense having five letters, with an additional تاء at the beginning and an additional واو between the عين and لام of the verb.

f: What is the usual meaning/function of the pattern تَفَعْوَلَ?
b: It is generally used for intransitive verbs (اللُّزوم).

f: Give an example of the pattern تَفَعْوَلَ used as an intransitive verb.
b: تَرَهْوَكَ زَيْدٌ.

f: What is the pattern of the augmented triliteral verb تَفَعْلَى يَتَفَعْلَى تَفَعْلِيًا?
b: Its pattern is تَفَعْلَى يَتَفَعْلَى تَفَعْلِيًا. Its example pattern is تَسَلْقَى يَتَسَلْقَى تَسَلْقِيًا.

f: How is the pattern تَفَعْلَى recognized?
b: It is recognized by the past tense having five letters, with an additional تاء at the beginning and an additional ياء at the end.

f: What is the usual meaning/function of the pattern تَفَعْلَى?
b: It is generally used for intransitive verbs (اللُّزوم).

f: Give an example of the pattern تَفَعْلَى and explain its meaning.
b: تَسَلْقَى زَيْدٌ meaning “Zayd lay on his back.”

f: What does the term مُلْحَق mean in Arabic morphology?
b: It refers to a word pattern that is made to resemble another pattern by adding letters so that its structure matches the original pattern.

f: In augmented forms such as تَجَلْبَبَ, where does the actual morphological augmentation for إلحاق occur?
b: The actual augmentation occurs through the addition of a letter other than the تاء, because the تاء is added for the meaning of المطاوعة (receiving the effect of another action).

f: In the word تَجَلْبَبَ, what is the letter responsible for the إلحاق?
b: The additional باء (the repetition of the باء) creates the إلحاق; the تاء is added for the meaning of مطاوعة.

f: Why is the تاء in words like تَدَحْرَجَ not considered the letter of إلحاق?
b: Because إلحاق does not occur at the beginning of a word; it occurs in the middle or end. The تاء is instead added for the meaning of مطاوعة.

f: What are the two patterns that are attached to احْرَنْجَمَ (مُلْحَق احْرَنْجَمَ)?
b: The two patterns are: 1. افْعَنْلَلَ 2. افْعَنْلَى

f: What is the pattern of افْعَنْلَلَ يَفْعَنْلِلُ افْعِنْلَالاً?
b: Its pattern is افْعَنْلَلَ يَفْعَنْلِلُ افْعِنْلَالاً. Its example is اقْعَنْسَسَ يَقْعَنْسِسُ اقْعِنْسَاسًا.

f: How is the pattern افْعَنْلَلَ recognized?
b: It is recognized by the past tense having six letters, with an additional همزة at the beginning, a نون between the عين and the first لام, and another letter from the same جنس as the second لام at the end.

f: What is the usual meaning/function of افْعَنْلَلَ?
b: It indicates intensification of an intransitive action (مبالغة اللازم).

f: Give an example showing the difference between قَعَسَ and اقْعَنْسَسَ.
b: قَعَسَ الرجلُ means his chest protruded generally; اقْعَنْسَسَ الرجلُ means his chest protruded and his back became curved inward, with greater intensity.

f: What is the pattern of افْعَنْلَى يَفْعَنْلِي افْعِنْلَاءً?
b: Its pattern is افْعَنْلَى يَفْعَنْلِي افْعِنْلَاءً. Its example is اسْلَنْقَى يَسْلَنْقِي اسْلِنْقَاءً.

f: How is the pattern افْعَنْلَى recognized?
b: It is recognized by the past tense having six letters, with an additional همزة at the beginning, a نون between the عين and لام, and an additional ياء at the end.

f: What is the usual meaning/function of افْعَنْلَى?
b: It is used for intransitive verbs (اللُّزوم).

f: Give an example of the pattern افْعَنْلَى.
b: اسْلَنْقَى زَيْدٌ.

f: What are the eight divisions (الأقسام الثمانية) of verbs according to whether they are basic/augmented and sound/unsound?
b: The eight divisions are: 1. Sound basic triliteral (ثلاثي مجرد سالم) مثل كَرُمَ. 2. Unsound basic triliteral (ثلاثي مجرد غير سالم) مثل وَعَدَ. 3. Sound basic quadriliteral (رباعي مجرد سالم) مثل دَحْرَجَ. 4. Unsound basic quadriliteral (رباعي مجرد غير سالم) مثل وَسْوَسَ وزَلْزَلَ. 5. Sound augmented triliteral (ثلاثي مزيد فيه سالم) مثل أَكْرَمَ. 6. Unsound augmented triliteral (ثلاثي مزيد فيه غير سالم) مثل أَوْعَدَ. 7. Sound augmented quadriliteral (رباعي مزيد فيه سالم) مثل تَدَحْرَجَ. 8. Unsound augmented quadriliteral (رباعي مزيد فيه غير سالم) مثل تَوَسْوَسَ.

f: What are the two main categories into which every verb is divided?
b: Every verb is either sound (صحيح) or defective/unsound (معتل).

f: What is a sound verb (الفعل الصحيح)?
b: A sound verb is one in which none of the letters corresponding to the فاء، عين، لام of the verb is a letter of weakness or another defect.

f: What letters are considered letters of defect (حروف العلة وما يلحق بها)?
b: They are: الواو، الياء، الألف، الهمزة، والتضعيف.

f: Give an example of a sound verb.
b: نَصَرَ.

f: What is a defective verb (الفعل المعتل)?
b: A defective verb is one in which one of the root positions (فاء، عين، لام) contains a letter of defect.

f: What is an example of a verb defective in its first root letter (معتل الفاء)?
b: وَعَدَ and يَسَرَ.

f: What is the defective verb whose first root letter is weak called?
b: It is called مثال (معتل الفاء) because the weakness occurs in the فاء of the verb.

f: What is a hollow verb (الفعل الأجوف)?
b: A hollow verb is one whose middle root letter (عين الفعل) is a letter of defect.

f: Give examples of hollow verbs.
b: قَالَ and كَالَ.

f: What is a defective-final verb (الفعل الناقص)?
b: A defective-final verb is one whose final root letter (لام الفعل) is a letter of defect.

f: Give examples of defective-final verbs.
b: غَزَا and رَمَى.

f: What is a doubled verb (الفعل المضاعف)?
b: A doubled verb is one whose second and third root letters (عينه ولامه) are of the same type.

f: Give an example of a doubled verb.
b: مَدَّ. Its original form is مَدَدَ.

f: How was مَدَّ derived from مَدَدَ?
b: The vowel of the first دال was removed, then the first دال was merged into the second دال through assimilation (الإدغام).

f: What is a defective verb with two weak letters called?
b: It is called لفيف.

f: How many types of لفيف are there?
b: There are two types: لفيف مقرون and لفيف مفروق.

f: What is a لفيف مقرون?
b: It is a verb in which both the عين and لام positions contain letters of defect.

f: Give an example of لفيف مقرون.
b: طَوَى.

f: What is a لفيف مفروق?
b: It is a verb in which both the فاء and لام positions contain letters of defect.

f: Give an example of لفيف مفروق.
b: وَقَى.

f: How many categories of defective verbs are there?
b: The defective verb categories are seven: مثال، أجوف، ناقص، لفيف مقرون، لفيف مفروق، مضاعف، مهموز.

f: What is assimilation (الإدغام) in Arabic morphology?
b: Assimilation is the insertion of one of two similar letters (المتجانسين) into the other.

f: How many types of assimilation (الإدغام) are there?
b: There are three types: obligatory (واجب), permissible (جائز), and forbidden (ممتنع).

f: When is assimilation obligatory (الإدغام الواجب)?
b: It is obligatory when the two similar letters are both vowelled, or when the first is silent and the second is vowelled.

f: Give an example of obligatory assimilation.
b: مَدَّ يَمُدُّ مَدًّا. The original form is مَدَدَ.

f: When is assimilation permissible (الإدغام الجائز)?
b: It is permissible when the first of the two similar letters is vowelled and the second is temporarily silent (سكون عارض).

f: Give an example of permissible assimilation.
b: لَمْ يَمُدَّ. Its original form is لَمْ يَمْدُدْ.

f: How is لَمْ يَمُدَّ derived from لَمْ يَمْدُدْ?
b: The vowel of the first دال is transferred to the preceding letter, then the second دال receives a temporary vowel, and the two دال letters are merged.

f: What is the unfused (non-assimilated) form of لَمْ يَمُدَّ?
b: لَمْ يَمْدُدْ.

f: When is assimilation forbidden (الإدغام الممتنع)?
b: It is forbidden when the first similar letter is vowelled and the second has an original permanent sukun.

f: Give an example of forbidden assimilation.
b: مَدَدْتُ cannot become مَدَّتُ, because the second دال has original sukun.

f: What is a hamzated verb (الفعل المهموز)?
b: A hamzated verb is one in which one of its original root letters is a hamzah.

f: Give examples of hamzated verbs.
b: أَخَذَ، سَأَلَ، قَرَأَ.

f: What is a verb called when the hamzah is in the فاء position?
b: It is called مهموز الفاء.

f: What is a verb called when the hamzah is in the عين position?
b: It is called مهموز العين.

f: What is a verb called when the hamzah is in the لام position?
b: It is called مهموز اللام.

f: What are the seven categories of defective verbs collectively called?
b: They are called الأقسام السبعة.
